raw.en: If the image of an object formed by a concave mirror is virtual, erect and larger than the object then where should be the location of the object ? notes: Continues Q30 English options (answer (D) Between the pole and principal focus of the mirror), then Q31-32, all Physics. Answer key: Q31=(A) the power of lens, Q32=(D) all of these (chhota+seedha+aabhasi). Q32 English options continue on next page.
